description:
Liella no Uta is a weekly animated music segment shown with each Love Live! Superstar!! episode exclusively on the NHK Educational TV (NHK E) broadcast of the TV anime. These shorts will later be released across all 6 volumes of the Blu-ray/DVD releases of Love Live! Superstar!!. The title is in reference to NHK's program, Minna no Uta.

The list of released animations included in this entry are as follows:
#1) Primary (Liella!)
#2) Memories (Shibuya Kanon)
#3) Memories (Arashi Chisato)
#4) Anniversary (Tang Keke)
#5) Anniversary (Hazuki Ren)
#6) Message (Heanna Sumire)
#7) Message (Shibuya Kanon)
#8) Ringing! (Arashi Chisato)
#9) Ringing! (Tang Keke)
#10) Dears (Hazuki Ren)
#11) Dears (Heanna Sumire)
#12) Departure (Liella!)
